rationale: A directly focused proprioception systematic review was published in 2022.
A higher-level systematic review and meta-analysis was published in 2024.
An RCT-only systematic review and meta-analysis published in 2025 searched through November 2024 and included proprioception.
A 2026 retrospective cohort is relevant for surveillance but does not alone justify duplicating the same broad review question.
next_action: Reframe around a defensible unresolved question, such as effect modification by objectively graded remnant quality or continuity, and verify novelty again before protocol registration.
limitations: This is a dated scoping snapshot, not an exhaustive systematic search.
No study eligibility, outcome extraction, Risk of Bias, or meta-analysis was performed.
The repository must not convert this decision into an automated novelty score.
